subject: MediTrust: request for granular log retention & PII redaction evidence (SIG/CAIQ)
messages:
From: Paul Bryant <pbryant@meditrust.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Meditrust Security Team <security@meditrust.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: granular log retention policy + PII redaction details for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Neha / Marissa,

We are running Redwood through our vendor SIG assessment and a few questions came up from our security reviewers around log retention and PII handling that are blocking our procurement review. High level asks:

- Can Redwood provide tenant-scoped retention controls (different TTLs per customer/tenant) and the evidence that those controls are implemented?
- Is there an option to retain only metadata for 30 days while keeping full message traces for 180 days (for customers under forensic hold)?
- What redaction/de-identification mechanisms exist for logs that contain PII (e.g., SSNs, MRNs) before logs leave the tenant boundary? We need a short description and any sample CAIQ/SIG responses you can share.

Specific timelines: our compliance team would like the answers + artifacts by EOD Thu (24 Jul) so we can close the SIG review on Friday. If there are any blockers or required approvals, please flag them — we can escalate from our side.

Thanks,
Paul
Paul Bryant
Security Lead, Meditrust Health
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Paul Bryant <pbryant@meditrust.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: granular log retention policy + PII redaction details for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Paul — thanks for the clear list. Looping in our security/compliance ops lead Marissa so we can provide the concrete artifacts. Quick answers up front:

- Tenant-scoped TTLs: yes. Redwood supports per-tenant retention via policy tags; standard hosted tenants default to 30d token/session retention and 90d debug-trace retention, but customers on Dedicated/Private can request tailored retention windows (we capture this as an ACL in the config and persist an immutable retention tag on ingested events).

- Forensic hold: we can place a tenant under a temporary forensic hold that preserves full traces for a configurable window (commonly 180d). We keep a separate snapshot index for retained-forensics traces and apply strict access controls/audit logging to access those snapshots.

- PII redaction: we support both pre-ingest client-side tokenization guidance and server-side PII scrubbing pipelines. Server-side scrubbing runs pattern-based redaction (SSN, emails, MRN) and optional regex/PII classifier hooks; redaction rules are applied before logs are sent to long-term indices or exported.

I'm attaching a high-level SOC2 summary and a CAIQ export (redacted) to start; Marissa and I will follow up with the SIG mappings and a short evidence packet. If you need formal signed attestations, call that out and we'll surface our SOC2 report.

Attachments: SOC2-type2-2024-summary.pdf, CAIQ-export-answers-2025.csv

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Meditrust: request for granular log retention & PII redaction evidence (SIG/CAIQ)

Internal notes / suggested evidence pack (reply-all to external once Ben confirms):

- For tenant-scoped TTLs: deliver an export of the policy config schema (JSON snippet) + a short screenshot from the Console showing per-tenant retention selection. (We can sanitize the JSON to hide internal cluster ids.)
- For forensic hold: provide the 'forensic_hold_runbook_v2.pdf' excerpt and an example hold manifest (redacted) showing preservation of full traces for 180d.
- For redaction: include the PII scrubbing pipeline description and a short test sample demonstrating redaction before export.
- SIG mapping: attach the SIG Lite/answers subset (we rarely publish full SIG publicly) — draft attached 'sig_matrix_draft.xlsx' to confirm which CCs we can release.

Risks / blockers: dedicated tenant-specific evidence for production-only features (forensics snapshot) requires a quick legal sign-off if it contains internal hostnames or team contacts. Ben — can you confirm the last two items and whether we can share the hold manifest sample (redacted) and the pipeline test sample? If legal needs to redact, we'll note that in the cover email to Meditrust.

Marissa
Director, Security Ops
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Paul Bryant <pbryant@meditrust.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meditrust: request for granular log retention & PII redaction evidence (SIG/CAIQ)

Hi Paul — Ben from Redwood Security Ops here. Thanks for the timeline; we can deliver the requested artifacts by end of day. What we'll include in the package (attached as a ZIP with redacted artifacts):

1) Policy evidence: sanitized sample of the tenant retention policy schema + console screenshot showing the per-tenant TTL selector.
2) Forensic hold: redacted hold manifest template and excerpt from our forensic_hold_runbook_v2.pdf describing access controls and retention lifecycle (we will label any internal hostnames as REDACTED).
3) PII redaction: pipeline description and a small test log snippet before/after redaction (SSN and MRN patterns replaced with <REDACTED>).
4) SIG/CAIQ: CAIQ-export-answers-2025.csv (already sent by Neha) plus a SIG snippet bundle (sig_response_snippet.zip) that maps to the questions you flagged.

If Meditrust requires formal signed evidence (SOC2 full report) or an on-site evidence review, mention it and we will route to Legal for the NDA/attestation path. Otherwise deliverables are attached and we will provide a 30-minute review call tomorrow (Fri) to walk through.

Next steps: Paul — confirm whether the redaction examples are sufficient or whether you need schema-level PII classification outputs (we can include a classifier confidence summary if requested).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Security Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: sig_response_snippet.zip, sig_matrix_draft.xlsx
